propositions: Four read-only git-derivable metrics (module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, refactor_to_addition_ratio) must be implemented in src/rebar/metrics/git_metrics.py with deterministic, multi-argument raw functions that scan modules against a single hard cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt or extract events from git log --numstat.
Each metric function must be registered as a MetricSpec in REGISTRY with a single-argument context-adapter compute, lens='code_health', source='git', and confidence='high'.

module_size_distribution must return {count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, max_loc} by scanning src/rebar/**/*.py at a ref; cap_change_events must return list[dict] of cap-file changes from git log; churn must return {insertions, deletions} from git log --numstat; refactor_to_addition_ratio must return deletions/insertions or None when insertions is 0.

Unit tests must verify exact-value assertions on metric outputs against fixture git repos: module_size_distribution count/max_loc/over_cap_count, churn insertions/deletions, refactor_to_addition_ratio ratio and None cases, and cap_change_events list structure and empty-range result.
All four metric ids must be present in REGISTRY with correct lens, source, and confidence labels, verifiable by iterating REGISTRY and checking .id, .lens, .source, .confidence.
